name: Admin Panel Projects Module
description: The Plataforma space in the panel sidebar (after Contabilidad, doubling the superuser-only Hostings entry) opens /panel/projects: the commercial face of accounts.Project, the entity hostings, incomes and cuentas de cobro reference. The listing loads every scope at once and filters client-side: search over project and client name (accent/case-blind), a BaseSegmented Activos/Archivados/Todos (archived is a status, PA-29: projects archive, they never delete), sortable columns for name/client/status/created plus per-project hosting and income counts that — for superusers — link into the accounting tabs pre-filtered via ?project=<id> (incomes also pins accounting_incomeTab=all so the landing tab cannot hide settled rows). Stat cards count active/archived plus clients without any project; that card opens a panel listing each uncovered client with a Crear proyecto CTA that seeds the create modal. Create asks the PA-38 minimum — name plus a required client through ClientAutocomplete (inline client creation included) — with description/status optional; a same-name project for the same client raises a warning strip that never blocks. Edit keeps the client immutable and archived rows out of circulation; archive asks confirmation explaining the records stay linked, restore returns the row to Activos. At 412px and 835px the scope is a selector, sorting stays explicit and the listing becomes one/two-column project cards with metrics and a 44px action menu; the phone initially shows only the two primary KPIs behind a disclosure for the other two. At 1195px and above the sortable table returns. Create, edit, orphan assignment and guided client-change dialogs are full-screen on phones, with sticky actions and the impact preview stacked before its decision controls; the page is capped at 1400px on the 2560px monitor.
